ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity white pixels with a high contrast ratio relative to the thin low-intensity black perimeter; estimated white-to-black pixel ratio exceeding 15:1.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white region occupies the central and lateral fluke areas. Low-intensity black pixels are mapped to the immediate trailing edge and distal tips. Distinct low-intensity geometric clusters are present near the fluke-peduncle junction: a single circular spot on the left lateral side and a vertical elongated mark on the right lateral side.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Defined V-shaped central depression with an approximate internal angle of 115 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous serrated boundary with variable frequency; high-amplitude, irregular peaks are concentrated at the distal tips, while low-amplitude, more regular serrations extend along the trailing edge toward the notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex sweep trajectory along the trailing edge, exhibiting a symmetric tapering towards the distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple short, vertical dark linear pixel disruptions located centrally above the waterline.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinctive dark pigmentation marks at the base of the fluke; the right distal tip (image right) displays irregular trailing edge erosion.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique spatial configuration of two dark focal marks near the median longitudinal axis at the peduncle transition.
